/bin/zsh -lc "rtk /opt/anaconda3/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 390, \"height\": 844}, reduced_motion=\"reduce\")
    page.goto(\"http://127.0.0.1:8876/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")
    page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    checks = {
        \"viewport_width\": page.evaluate(\"window.innerWidth\"),
        \"document_scroll_width\": page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\"),
        \"page_horizontal_overflow\": page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth\"),
        \"reduced_motion\": page.evaluate(\"matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches\"),
        \"named_buttons\": page.locator(\"button\").evaluate_all(\"(nodes) => nodes.every(n => (n.textContent || '').trim() || n.getAttribute('aria-label'))\"),
        \"global_controls_named\": page.locator(\"#stopRunButton,#resumeRunButton,#emergencyRunButton,#refreshButton\").evaluate_all(\"(nodes) => nodes.every(n => (n.textContent || '').trim() && n.getAttribute('type') === 'button')\"),
        \"drawer_aria_modal\": page.locator(\"#drawerCard\").get_attribute(\"aria-modal\"),
        \"drawer_initially_hidden\": page.locator(\"#jobDrawer\").get_attribute(\"aria-hidden\"),
    }
    page.locator(\"#allViewButton\").click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(400)
    row = page.locator(\".jobs-table .link-button\").first
    row.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    checks[\"drawer_open_focus\"] = page.evaluate(\"document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id\")
    page.keyboard.press(\"Shift+Tab\")
    checks[\"drawer_shift_tab_wrap_focus\"] = page.evaluate(\"document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id\")
    page.keyboard.press(\"Escape\")
    checks[\"drawer_closed_after_escape\"] = page.locator(\"#jobDrawer\").get_attribute(\"aria-hidden\")
    checks[\"drawer_return_focus\"] = page.evaluate(\"document.activeElement && document.activeElement.textContent\")
    checks[\"drawer_focus_trap\"] = checks[\"drawer_shift_tab_wrap_focus\"] == \"saveNoteButton\"
    checks[\"drawer_returned_to_origin\"] = \"Medical Records Specialist\" in (checks[\"drawer_return_focus\"] or \"\")
    browser.close()
print(json.dumps(checks, sort_keys=True))

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk /opt/anaconda3/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3, re
paths = [\"/tmp/jobbot-chg146-r5-live-crawl_observations.sqlite3\", \"/tmp/jobbot-chg146-r5-glassdoor21-crawl_observations.sqlite3\"]
for path in paths:
    con=sqlite3.connect(path)
    rows=con.execute(\"select platform,source_job_id,normalized_card_json,detail_job_json,detail_provenance_json,content_completeness,source_build from crawl_observations\").fetchall()
    safe=[]
    for platform,source_id,card,detail,prov,complete,build in rows:
        vals=[card,detail,prov]
        joined=\" \".join(vals).lower()
        forbidden=sorted(set(re.findall(r\"(?i)(?:cookie|password|credential|access[_ -]?token|refresh[_ -]?token|session[_ -]?id|bridge[_ -]?token|secret)\", joined)))
        safe.append({\"platform\":platform,\"source_job_id\":source_id,\"card_keys\":sorted(json.loads(card).keys()),\"detail_keys\":sorted(json.loads(detail).keys()),\"provenance_keys\":sorted(json.loads(prov).keys()),\"content_completeness\":complete,\"source_build\":build,\"forbidden_key_terms\":forbidden})
    print(path)
    print(json.dumps(safe,sort_keys=True))
    con.close()
